teacher.tools: disallowed; reject a job containing tool events

episodes.comparison_scope: Matched development scenes of seen tasks, not held-out OOD.
episodes.history_cost: Each guided attempt has access to its one already charged native failure. Report this preparation separately from guided rollout cost; it is not zero-shot guidance.

teacher_observations.current: All three unmodified 224x224 policy-input RGB cameras and native 16D state before execution.
teacher_observations.previous_live: The preceding teacher-review observation, after the first call.
teacher_observations.historical: Four fixed chronological panoramas from the paired failed native video, sampled at indices floor((frame_count-1)*[0.25,0.5,0.75,1]). Video frames follow every two executed controls; historical proprioception is unavailable and null.
teacher_observations.other_context: Original instruction, preceding two proposals, active subgoal, remaining call budget, prior observed binary failure and horizon.

intervention.application: Retain original instruction and append ' Current phase: ' plus the chosen subgoal (at most 160 characters).
intervention.between_reviews: Reuse the active language setting while the native policy replans every five controls.
intervention.after_last_review_interval: Revert to original instruction and record budget exhaustion.

accounting.success: Original environment binary success predicate; no teacher-defined success or best-of retries.
accounting.reset_free_segment: One actually executed nonempty policy prefix of at most five controls.
accounting.incomplete_batch: No full-batch SR claim; retain all started episodes and missing scheduled episodes.
accounting.tokens: Real Codex usage including failed/rejected jobs. Unknown usage remains unknown. Input includes cached tokens and harness overhead; reasoning is a subset of output.
accounting.money: Unverified for subscription-backed Codex; do not infer zero marginal token cost or apply unverified API pricing.
accounting.latency: Separate teacher latency, native policy inference, full wall time, and charged GPU allocation including initialization.

amendment.reason: One uint8 wrist-camera color value differed by one level at seed1; exact physical state, scene XML, proprioception and both other camera tensors matched. The original check stopped before controls or teacher calls.
amendment.preservation: Keep the completed seed0 attempt and the seed1 rejected reset; resume only five pairs without completed guided episodes. No best-of reroll of seed0.
